opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Our Main Grants fund (the Research, Development and Analysis Fund) offers up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research proposals that address one or more of the priority questions and meet the assessment criteria.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research proposals that contribute to understanding, public debate, policy and/or practice on tackling racial inequalities, discrimination and disadvantage.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on racial inequalities, discrimination, and pathways to racial justice.
